prompt.project_info: Create a playful escalator selfie of an approved adult woman in a mall or station.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-white short wavy bob hair, light blue-grey eyes, natural minimal makeup, wearing an opaque cream short-sleeve top with secure coverage and a black shoulder bag.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle smartphone selfie from above, face and upper body visible, playful tongue-out expression, metal escalator steps, black handrail, and a non-identifiable background passerby. Avoid cleavage emphasis and keep the camera angle non-voyeuristic.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor mall or station lighting, casual spontaneous public-space mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, portrait 3:4, controlled overhead angle, natural skin texture, realistic escalator geometry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with platinum-white short wavy bob hair takes a playful overhead escalator selfie, looking up with a silly tongue-out expression. She wears an opaque cream top with secure coverage and a black shoulder bag. Show metal escalator steps, handrail, soft mall lighting, and a non-identifiable passerby. Keep framing casual and non-voyeuristic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, deep neckline, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized overhead framing, nudity, distorted escalator, extra fingers, blurred face, identifiable background person, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

changes: Replaced thin-strap styling and provocative angle emphasis with opaque coverage and non-voyeuristic framing; anonymized the background person.
